card.title: Snap any object
card.body: It starts with a photo of anything: a mug, a trainer, a banana. In the machine the photo is a card fed into the coin slot. Rollers draw it under a scanner head, and the picture goes up to the model.

gemma.title: Gemma 4 invents the character
gemma.body: Gemma 4 looks at the photo, decides what the object is and gives it a googly-eyed personality. It writes the bars and the comebacks, and it judges how witty your reply is.

voice.title: A voice for every object
voice.body: Each object gets a voice designed for it, and ElevenLabs v3 raps its roast over the beat. Scribe transcribes your bars as you rap them, and the crowd reactions are generated sound effects.

screen.title: The character on stage
screen.body: The character comes alive on screen. Its mouth moves to the words, its pupils jiggle on the beat and its roast types out in a speech bubble.

mic.title: Your phone becomes the mic
mic.body: Then it is your turn. You hold your phone like a mic and freestyle back. The machine counts the words it hears and fires a comeback.

crowd.title: The audience decides
crowd.body: The audience scans a QR code and votes on their phones: cheer, laugh or boo. Votes and wit are combined into a score out of 100, and 60 or more beats the object.

marquee.title: Best Use of Gemma 4
marquee.body: dissPICable won Best Use of Gemma 4 at Hacktoberfest Hack Day Manchester 2026. It was built in a day with Debanjan Ray and Hussain Afham.
